description: This file defines the Special controller class for the Opencart admin module, handling CRUD operations and rendering views for special modules.

classes.name: Special
classes.description: Controller class for managing special modules in the Opencart admin panel, including index, save, add, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the special module configuration page with breadcrumbs, module info, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating a special module's configuration, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new special module with default name, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module by ID, with permission check and JSON response.
